compendium.summary: Endgame flexible form engine with retained class features as allowed.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Endgame form spell. Track it before assuming the spell is available.
Pre-cast gate: Use a legally known form and verify retained statistics, concentration, control, and ending state.
Failure state: Illegal form knowledge, lost concentration, misunderstood spellcasting, or uncontrolled created creature.
Safe operating default: Prepare a small verified form library and a safe reversion plan.
